finding.title: Concurrent stale refill rejects an allowed stream with available shared bytes
finding.before_fix_result: First reserve succeeds; second fails with Quota storage unavailable while 262143 bytes remain available and 1 byte pending
finding.fix: Replan zero-grant refills; require charged < MAX_COUNTER before queuing refill
finding.after_fix: Deterministic queued TCP/UDP refills and counter-boundary regressions pass
